profile.summary: A chapter of the American Orff-Schulwerk Association, founded in 1973, serving music and dance educators in the greater San Francisco Bay Area and Northern California. It offers professional development workshops in music and movement and other resources for teaching inspired by Orff Schulwerk, an approach to music education based on singing, chanting, clapping, dancing and playing instruments.
